contactMaterials.assumption: Nominal clean, dry surfaces; validate against physical props before hardware transfer.

surfaces.hand: Dry compliant textured rubber grasp surfaces (assumed)

apple.handBasis: Optimistic dry rubber/apple-skin simulation estimate; not a measured or calibrated fruit contact.

can.handBasis: Adams dry rubber/aluminium static 0.80, dynamic 0.76; coating and actual pad remain uncalibrated.

bottle.handBasis: Upper dry-grip estimate; analogy to rubber/acrylic and rubber/nylon, not measured PET.

mug.handBasis: Upper dry rubber/glaze grip estimate; no matched measured coefficient.

uiuc_i.handBasis: Optimistic dry soft-rubber/wood estimate; paint and pad differ from published rubber-belt/panel tests.

contactMaterials.frictionModel: One Coulomb sliding coefficient; separate static and dynamic friction are not modeled.

references.note: Generalized literature-based table, not measurements of Dex3 or these props.
Rubber belt against wood panels; different surfaces and loading from a painted wood grasp prop.

contactMaterials.combination: Explicit object-hand, object-tabletop and object-tray contact-pair estimates. Other contacts use MuJoCo geom defaults; the hand geom value is a fallback, not a universal material coefficient.
